title: Why do spiders spin webs?
examples: Do spiders use their webs to build houses?
Is the spider web sticky or just strong?
What do spiders do if their web breaks?

explain.say: Spiders spin webs for a few reasons.
The main reason is to catch food, like small insects.
Spiders make webs from silk. The silk is very strong.
A spider feels shaking in its web. These vibrations tell it that food is there.
Look for garden spiders on a dewy morning. Their webs shine with water drops.
Webs are sticky, and they are strong too.

faq.q: Do spiders use their webs to build houses?
faq.a: Spiders use webs for many things, but their main home is usually a small retreat or corner.
asks: Do they build a nest with webs?

faq.a: Yes. Some threads are sticky, to trap insects. The silk is strong too.
asks: Is the stickiness the only job?

faq.q: What happens if a big animal touches the web?
faq.a: A big animal might break the web, but the spider can usually repair it with new silk threads.
No, some spiders, like jumping spiders, do not build large webs to catch food.
asks: Do all spiders catch food in webs?
Are there spider types without webs?

faq.q: How do spiders know where to put their web?
faq.a: They usually build webs between safe, sheltered places like leaves or branches.
asks: Do they plan where to build?

facts: Spider silk is one of the strongest natural materials known.
Spiders use vibrations in the web to detect prey.
Webs help spiders rest and feel safe from predators.
Some spiders hunt by jumping instead of using webs.

quiz.say: What are the sticky threads of a web for?
quiz.why: Insects stick to the threads, and the spider eats them.

wrong.1: Webs are quiet, and their job is catching food.
wrong.2: A web is full of holes, so it keeps nothing warm.

quiz.say: A spider feels its web shake. What does that tell it?

options.show: something is caught in the web
options.say: something is caught in the web

quiz.why: Shaking tells the spider something has landed in the web. It might be food.

wrong.0: Shaking means something touched the web.
wrong.1: A new web stays still until something touches it.

quiz.why: Spider silk is very strong for how thin it is.

wrong.0: Silk is very light, so it floats on the air.
wrong.2: Spiders make silk inside their own bodies.
